sections.text:
-Target: all enemies. Ability Power 800. Success value 100. 2x physical damage that pierces through damage reduction/reflection effects (Time).
Ability Power boosted by 10 for each increase in Skill level.
-Target: all allies. Increases all stats by 200% for 150 seconds.
-Target: all allies. Increases buff limit for all stats by 120% for 150 seconds.
-Target: all allies. Increases Cost recovery speed by 10 for 150 seconds.
-Target: all allies. Increases Unison gauge gains by 2 for 150 seconds.
-Target: yourself. Applies Siege for 150 seconds (When in effect, damage to HP and CP will not be taken; [Special] increases ATK and MATK by 100%; nullifies debuffs; nullifies status ailments; nullifies special status ailments; nullifies special debuffs; Applies Vital Strike (10% chance to increase damage dealt by 50%). Removed after receiving a set amount of damage (300% of max HP excluding buff and field effects)).
-Applies Guilty Eclipse (nullifies newly applied buff effects, blocks max HP increase effects, reduces action speed by 30, and reduces HP recovery effects by 100% (Heal Resistance)) to the enemy Field for 90 seconds.
Increases stats selected in stat slot 1 and stat slot 2 by 50000

[Additional Unison Effect] Target: all allies. Applies kijin (increases max HP by 100%; nullifies debuffs; nullifies Unison gauge reduction; boosts Ability Power of critical hits by 50; increases attack Ability accuracy by 30%; permits piercing through damage reduction, damage reflection, and damage nullifying effects when attacking) for 150 seconds.

[SEES] Aigis or Ninoyu with the same or higher Cost of the base Monster can be used as fodder.
 *Specific Monsters may also be used. See the Help section for details.
